description: US Treasury auctions (FiscalData): Bills, Notes, Bonds, TIPS, FRNs, cash-management bills. One row = one CUSIP's auction: announcement fields first; results (bid_to_cover_ratio, high/average yield, bidder breakdowns, Fed SOMA allocation) null until they publish. since/until: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date (auction_date by default). Defaults: auction_date desc, 50 rows. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_treasury_auctions
name: get_treasury_auctions
